long_biography.plain_text:
The Jolley Group began in Oklahoma with Environmental Action, a small asbestos-abatement company. Under Anthony Don Jolley's leadership, that business became the foundation for a broader network assembled through the acquisition of eleven additional companies. The group retained its focus on technical construction and industrial services while extending across multiple states.

Its companies now cover fireproofing, commercial and industrial insulation, abrasive blasting, specialty coatings, scaffolding, fabrication, environmental remediation and pipeline work. Some units operate in power, petrochemical and oil-and-gas settings; others distribute insulation and safety supplies or support land and cattle operations.
